title: Chem Notes 11 — CBSE Class 11 Chemistry Named Reactions Notes (Frontend)

requirements.summary: Add a homepage that shows the exact credit text and provides navigation to the notes section.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting the app root route shows the exact text "made by PIYUSH SRIVASTAVA" (matching capitalization and spelling).
The homepage provides clear navigation to the named reactions notes section.

file_operations.description: Create the homepage UI that prominently renders the exact text "made by PIYUSH SRIVASTAVA" and includes a clear call-to-action link/button to the named reactions index. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button) for consistent layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a shared layout with a simple header/nav that includes a link to the named reactions section, ensuring consistent structure across pages. Use shadcn-ui components where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create the app root component and wire the root route to HomePage, including navigation to the named reactions index page (router setup and route registration).

requirements.summary: Create a named reactions index page listing reactions and linking to dedicated reaction detail pages.
acceptanceCriteria: There is a dedicated page that lists named reactions.
Each reaction entry links to a dedicated reaction details page (separate page/route).

file_operations.description: Add a static, frontend-only registry of the available named reactions (title, slug/route key, and associated static image asset paths) for rendering the index and details pages.

Create the named reactions index page that lists all reactions from the static registry and links each item to its dedicated reaction page. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button) for list styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create the reaction detail page that reads the route parameter (reaction slug) and renders the corresponding reaction content based on the static registry (no backend calls).
Wire navigation and routing for the named reactions index route and the reaction detail route(s), and ensure they render within the shared SiteLayout.

requirements.summary: Render handwritten notes as static images on each reaction page with responsive viewing and a larger-view option.
acceptanceCriteria: Each reaction page renders at least one handwritten-notes image from static assets.
Images are readable on both mobile and desktop (responsive scaling and sensible margins).
A user can view the notes at a larger size (e.g., open in a dialog/lightbox or dedicated full-view).

file_operations.description: Create a reusable notes image viewer that displays a responsive inline image and supports click-to-open a larger view using a shadcn-ui Dialog (lightbox-style). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Use NotesImageViewer to render one or more handwritten note images for the selected reaction from static assets, ensuring responsive layout and a larger-view interaction.
Add global styling to support readable image presentation (sensible margins, max-width behavior, and consistent typography) across mobile and desktop while remaining theme-consistent.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent, chemistry-notes-appropriate visual theme across all pages, avoiding a blue/purple primary look.
acceptanceCriteria: A single consistent theme is used across all pages (typography, color palette, and layout).
Theme does not use a blue/purple primary look by default.

file_operations.description: Define the site-wide theme via CSS variables and base styles (e.g., chalkboard/green or warm neutral primary, consistent typography, spacing) and ensure it applies globally (non-blue/purple primary by default).

Ensure the shared layout applies consistent spacing, typography hierarchy, and reusable page structure across the homepage, index, and reaction pages. Use shadcn-ui components where helpful; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Align homepage sections (hero, credit text, navigation CTA) with the global theme and shared layout styling for consistency.
Align the reactions listing UI with the global theme (typography, spacing, cards/buttons) for consistency.
Align reaction page layout and image viewer presentation with the global theme (typography and spacing) for consistency.

requirements.summary: Add all generated images as static frontend assets and reference them directly from the UI (no backend fetching).
acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI.
The app displays the generated images without any backend calls for image delivery.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static asset hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png to be used on the homepage as a decorative hero background (frontend-served static file).
Add the generated static asset note-wurtz.dim_1200x1600.png for the Wurtz Reaction notes page (frontend-served static file).
Add the generated static asset note-fittig.dim_1200x1600.png for the Fittig Reaction notes page (frontend-served static file).
Add the generated static asset note-wurtz-fittig.dim_1200x1600.png for the Wurtz-Fittig Reaction notes page (frontend-served static file).
Add the generated static asset note-kolbe.dim_1200x1600.png for the Kolbe's Electrolysis notes page (frontend-served static file).
Add the generated static asset note-reimer-tiemann.dim_1200x1600.png for the Reimer–Tiemann Reaction notes page (frontend-served static file).
Add the generated static asset note-cannizzaro.dim_1200x1600.png for the Cannizzaro Reaction notes page (frontend-served static file).

Reference the exact generated image filenames using full workspace paths under frontend/public/assets/generated (including hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png and each note-*.dim_1200x1600.png) so the UI renders them as static assets without backend calls.
Wire the hero background to use the static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png and ensure it is purely frontend-served (no backend fetch).
Ensure each reaction detail page renders its associated note image(s) via static asset references (no backend calls) using the entries in the static named reactions registry.
